shared_elements: small scattered figures around a larger dominant motif
incised or carved lines on a rough natural stone surface
outdoor stone monument photographed in situ with sky/landscape visible
justification: Both show profile animals and small hook- or crescent-shaped motifs scattered across a large natural stone surface photographed outdoors, and both stack smaller creatures above and beside a dominant central form. But A is a flat, filled-in red silhouette painting/pecking on a sloping rock sheet, dominated by one huge frontal human figure, whereas B is a three-dimensional carved pillar with modelled low relief organised into strict horizontal registers, so the manner of rendering and the compositional logic differ fundamentally.
